children: Notification and public disclosure of the grant of LTIP and RSU Awards to Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities ("PDMR")

McBride plc confirms that on 16 September 2026 awards were granted under the terms of the McBride plc 2023 Long-Term Incentive Plan (“LTIP Awards”) and the McBride plc 2020 Restricted Share Unit Plan (as amended) (“RSU Awards”) to the following individuals:
These awards will vest at the end of a three-year period and are subject to a two-year post-vesting holding period. The Awards will not require any payment from the individual.
This announcement and the following disclosures are made in accordance with Article 19 of the Market Abuse Regulation (Regulation 596/2014).
